context_and_flow.screen_type: Onboarding screen for a pregnancy/health app.
context_and_flow.ux_intent: Guide the user through the onboarding process and motivate them to continue by highlighting the benefits of the feature.
ux_patterns: The illustration is a character-based hero art placed at the top to set an empathetic, nurturing tone.
The CTA (Next) is a prominent, rounded button, contrasting with the soft background.
The layout is very clean with ample white space, characteristic of modern mobile design systems.
No major accessibility issues obvious; text contrast appears sufficient.

visual_keywords: Minimalist, flat character illustration, soft color palette, centered layout.
